steps.text: keyboard-switch: put JECh on 小鹤双拼 through JECh's own chat command

keyboard-switch: open the inventory and focus JEI's search bar with a mouse click (the harness's level is creative, so this is the creative inventory). JEI's field is not a widget of the open screen (measured on this row's 1.18.2 forge sibling), so the click goes through the client's own mouse handler — the only route JEI's overlay hears — at 1180,703, the bar's centre measured there (the GUI space is 1280x720 at the pinned GUI scale 2, so a 2560x1440 framebuffer pixel is GUI(pixel/2)); this scenario's own assertion is what confirms it here, and it needs re-measuring if JEI's layout changes
keyboard-switch: the bar is JEI's own field, so clear it the way a player would
keyboard-switch: 石头 is ui+tz on 小鹤双拼, so this key order must reach 石
keyboard-switch: 全拼's own key order is the negative control
keyboard-switch: back on 全拼, so nothing after this scenario depends on the switch
